What is the GIL (Global Interpreter Lock)?

Supplied answer
The GIL is a lock in CPython that allows only one thread to execute Python bytecode at a time. So
threads do not give true parallel CPU usage, though they still help for I/O-bound work like file or network
operations. For CPU-bound work use the multiprocessing module, which runs separate processes each
with their own GIL.
